archetypes.name: dyn-gantt-layout
archetypes.rationale: The change depends on exact width accounting across axis, borders, rows, and CLI defaults.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Gantt renderer width normalization and default-path cap. Check that the long-label total line budget is enforced only when width is omitted, and that explicit API or CLI widths remain uncapped. Verify axis, border, and row tracks use the same effective width and that filtered-empty output still bypasses the cap safely. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
